comment: Tool declarations for Centrum Badminton. The implementations live in internal/agenttools and are shared with every tenant - this file says WHICH of them this project uses, how the router recognises a question about them, and any NARROWING of the platform role ceiling. It can never add a role a tool does not already have; that is rejected at boot.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings for a day. Args: {date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today)}. Returns customer names, times, courts and status.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"date":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"the day to list, defaults to today"}}}

tools.name: book_slot
tools.description: Book a facility slot. Args: {facility_id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), start_time (HH:MM), end_time (HH:MM), customer_name, customer_phone?}. facility_id comes from get_availability.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking by id. Args: {booking_id}. Returns cancelled.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Show which court slots are free. Args: {date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today)}. Returns free and booked slots per court.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"date":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"the day to check, defaults to today"}}}

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Current court prices. Args: {}. Returns day and evening rates per facility.

tools.name: query_attendance
tools.description: Who is playing right now / on a given day. Args: {date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today)}.

tools.name: query_income
tools.description: Income for a period. Args: {from (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, defaults to this month), to (YYYY-MM-DD, EXCLUSIVE, defaults to next month)}. Received payments, with committed booking value shown separately.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"start date, inclusive, defaults to this month"},"to":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"end date, EXCLUSIVE, defaults to next month"}}}

tools.name: query_net_profit
tools.description: Net profit for a period, court revenue minus expenses. Args: {from, to}.

tools.name: query_range_summary
tools.description: Compare two periods. Args: {from, to}. Returns totals, the best day and the busiest slot.

tools.name: closing_report
tools.description: Daily closing report for a day. Args: {date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today)}.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"date":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"the day to close, defaults to today"}}}

tools.name: export_report_excel
tools.description: Build an Excel report and return a download marker. Args: {from, to, type (lapangan|kantin|semua, default semua)}.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"start date, inclusive"},"to":{"type":"string","format":"date","description":"end date, EXCLUSIVE"},"type":{"type":"string","enum":["lapangan","kantin","semua"],"description":"which ledger to export, default semua"}}}

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Stock level for a canteen item. Args: {name (may be partial)}.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"product or item name, may be partial"}}}

tools.name: adjust_stock
tools.description: Adjust stock. Args: {product_id, name, delta (signed) or count (absolute stock-take)}. Owner and staff use this for deliveries, damage and stock-takes.
tools.parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"product_id":{"type":"string"},"name":{"type":"string","description":"product name, may be partial"},"delta":{"type":"integer","description":"signed change to stock"},"count":{"type":"integer","minimum":0,"description":"absolute counted level for a stock-take; replaces delta"}}}

tools.name: query_kantin_summary
tools.description: Canteen takings for a period. Args: {from, to}. Excludes voided sales.

tools.name: topup_member
tools.description: Add balance to a member. Args: {name, phone, amount}.

tools.name: record_staff_payment
tools.description: Record a staff payment in the ledger. Args: {email, amount, method (cash|qris)}.

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder delivered via Telegram. Args: {text, when}. Only works inside a Telegram chat.
